reasoning_content: fnm stores node under ~/.local/share/fnm/node-versions. Let me set FNM_DIR persistently or create direct symlinks. Let me find the actual node bin.

action.command: find /root/.local/share/fnm -maxdepth 3 -name node -type f 2>/dev/null; find /root/.local/share/fnm -maxdepth 2 -type d 2>/dev/null | head; ls -la /usr/local/fnm/fnm

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "find /root/.local/share/fnm -maxdepth 3 -name node -type f 2>/dev/null; find /root/.local/share/fnm -maxdepth 2 -type d 2>/dev/null | head; ls -la /usr/local/fnm/fnm", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Find node binary"}
